ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION. MATTER CONTINUED TO MAY 7, 2020 AT 8:30 A.M. DEPT. 506 (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-05-2020 - CONTINUED ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION TO MAY-07-2020 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF GRANT CARLSON IS PRESENT. UGLY JUICE REPRESENTED BY GRANT CARLSON, IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT DEBORAH MITCHEL IS PRESENT. KENNETH BUTI, TESTIFIES ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT. DEFENDANT STATES TO THE COURT THAT THIS IS A LABOR RELATED MATTER AND THAT IT SHOULD BE HEARD IN FRONT OF THE LABOR BOARD/COMMISSION AND MAKES A VERBAL REQUEST FOR A CONTINUANCE UNTIL THIS HAS BEEN HEARD IN FRONT OF THE LABOR BOARD/COMMISSION. COURT MAKES INQUIRY WITH PARTIES PRESENT TO DETERMINE IF THIS REQEUST IS APPROPRIATE OR IF THE MATTER SHOULD GO FORWARD WITH TRIAL FOR TODAY. THE COURT DETERMINES THAT A CONTINUANCE FOR 90 DAYS IS WARRANTED. MATTER CONTINUED TO MAY 7, 2020 AT 8:30 A.M. ON THE COURT'S MOTION. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
